title: Terminology Mechanism For Plugin UI Labels
description: Introduce a "terminology" mechanism: every UI has a native terminology by default, and languages can define alternative complete term sets. Ship a "reuse"/"Wiederverwendung" terminology for puzzle 3d where "Objects"/"Vortices" become "Building components"/"Connection points" (en) and "Baukomponenten"/"Verbindungspunkte" (de). Add a Terminology dropdown to the OS Settings panel next to the existing Language dropdown. Implementation: ViewState gains locale/terminology fields passed from the OS shell into the plugin WASM boundary; AppDefinition gains a terminologies list; puzzle 3d resolves a compile-time-complete label struct per (terminology, locale) and remaps its emitted UiNode labels.
